title: Some say Mary made and governs the world—Biel, Alanus, Salazar after Bonaventure
source_text: LXXII. Quin eo usque nonnulli progrediuntur in Ecclesia Romana, ut dicant Mariam esse rerum causam, & mundum fecisse, eumque conservare & gubernare. Quippe haec sunt verba Gabrielis Biel, Ad illam enim, scilicet Mariam, sicut ad medium, sicut ad arcam Dei, sicut ad veram causam, sicut ad negotium saeculorum respiciunt, & qui in caelo habitant: & qui in inferno: qui nos praecesserunt: & qui nos sumus: & qui sequentur: & Nati natorum, & qui nascentur ab illis. Et de eadem Alanus, qui ut Sanctus colitur, totidem verbis dicit, Haec Maria est omnium Domina, quae mundum fecit universum, & quae in eo sunt omnia conservat & gubernat. Idcirco Salazar post Bonaventuram, non veretur virgini dicere, Dispositione tua Virgo sanctissima perseverat mundus, quem & tu cum Deo ab initio fundasti.
pass_a_gloss: Nay some in the Roman Church progress so far as to say that Mary is the cause of things, and made the world, and conserves and governs it. For these are the words of Gabriel Biel: For to her, namely Mary, as to a mean, as to the ark of God, as to the true cause, as to the business of the ages, look both those who dwell in heaven and those in hell: who have gone before us: and who we are: and who will follow: and the children of children, and who will be born from them. And of the same Alanus, who is cultivated as a Saint, says in as many words: This Mary is Lady of all, who made the universal world, and conserves and governs all things that are in it. Therefore Salazar after Bonaventure does not fear to say to the virgin: By thy disposition, most holy Virgin, the world perseveres, which thou also with God didst found from the beginning.
pass_b_english: Some go further: Mary as cause who made, conserves, and governs the world.
Biel and Alanus speak so; Salazar after Bonaventure: by her disposition the world she founded with God perseveres.
